desc: Satisfy your sweet tooth cravings with Betty Crocker Favorites Dark Chocolate Brownie Mix. This dark chocolate brownie mix is the quick and easy way to create moist, delectable brownies the whole family will love by adding just a few ingredients. Whip up this brownie baking mix in minutes by simply adding water, oil and eggs. Impress friends and family at your next gathering or brighten up a Tuesday with these decadent baked goods. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes. And today, you can still find those same products you grew up with on grocery shelves.
features:
• Deep Dark Chocolate Flavor – Crafted for a rich, intense chocolate experience that satisfies real chocolate lovers 
  • Quick & Simple – Just mix with water, oil, and eggs—ready to bake in under 5 minutes 
  • Moist & Chewy Texture – Delivers gooey, fudgy brownies with crisp edges—ideal for any occasion
  • Family-Sized Box – Larger 16.3 oz size for more servings—perfect for gatherings or leftovers 
  • Supports Schools – Participates in Box Tops for Education program—buy it, help schools
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Palm Oil, Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Starch, Carob Powder, Salt, Artificial Flavor, Canola Oil.
